payload.name: PlexElapsedTimeTag
payload.description: Vendor-shaped projection of ElapsedTimeTagResponse from /cm/exhaust/v1/event/tag/elapsed-time. Generated from the PLEX dictionary 2026-08-05, not hand-written. Read-only evidence: every field is nullable because a vendor's required flag describes their write contract, not what their read endpoint returns. Harmonization happens in the hub tenant.
